content.text: ki: one command for a scoped agent session
Day to day you only run ki. The rest set up, check and update the machine, and look after the vault.
the vault server only when KI_VAULT is set
The checks before a session starts
The one git path for the vault, used by the note-writing skills, by you after hand edits, and by the cluster pusher. It fails closed and never resolves a conflict on its own.
KI_VAULT is a clone with an origin, the identity
allows the vault, the commit email matches,
no rebase is open, HEAD is on a branch
the next run refuses until the rebase is finished
ki reads which repo you are in, looks it up in projects.yaml, and starts your agent with the right brains, knowledge-base token and GitHub identity.
ki starts an agent with scope and identity; status shows the result
doctor checks tokens, KB reach, gh logins and attribution;
update pulls the harness, reinstalls ki and relinks skills
ki refuses rather than guesses: an unknown repo or the wrong commit email stops it, and a sensitive brain switches to a separate token.
push commits and pushes the vault; mcp serves it to agents
validate checks projects.yaml the same way ingest does
ki-mcp then grants only the brains that token allows; anything else is an error
